# ankra_addon_definition (Resource)

An organisation add-on definition (`ankra helm addon-definitions`): a curated add-on in the organisation's catalogue, the rules that match charts to it, and explicit chart links that include or exclude one chart of a registry whatever the rules say. Fields and chart links change in place; changing `name` replaces the definition. Ankra's global definitions are read-only and cannot be managed. Destroy deletes the definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_addon_definition" "observability" {
  name              = "observability"
  display_name      = "Observability stack"
  category          = "monitoring"
  match_chart_names = ["kube-prometheus-stack"]

  chart_links = [{
    chart_name   = "grafana"
    registry_url = "https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts"
    link_type    = "include"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the catalogue, at most 200 characters.
- `name` (String) Definition name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 100 characters. Changing it replaces the definition.

### Optional

- `category` (String) Catalogue category.
- `chart_links` (Attributes Set) Explicit links that include or exclude one chart of a registry, overriding the match rules for it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chart_links))
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `documentation_url` (String) Documentation address.
- `icon_url` (String) Icon address.
- `match_chart_names` (Set of String) Chart names that match the definition.
- `match_home_url_prefixes` (Set of String) Chart home address prefixes that match the definition.
- `match_keywords` (Set of String) Chart keywords that match the definition.
- `website_url` (String) Project website.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the definition.

<a id="nestedatt--chart_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chart_links`

Required:

- `chart_name` (String) Chart name.
- `link_type` (String) `include` or `exclude`.
- `registry_url` (String) Address of the registry holding the chart.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by definition name.
terraform import ankra_addon_definition.observability observability
```
